speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I am Dr. Agent, and I see you are a newborn presenting with respiratory distress. To help me understand your condition, please tell me your gestational age, whether you were born prematurely, and if you have any known congenital anomalies or infections.

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, born at 33 weeks of gestation. The newborn is presenting with respiratory distress 2 hours after birth. The mother had an uneventful pregnancy until premature onset of labor. There was no significant prenatal care history mentioned.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Respiratory Distress Syndrome.
Given the history of prematurity at 33 weeks and immediate onset of respiratory distress, the clinical picture is highly suggestive of RDS due to surfactant deficiency. I will proceed with confirmatory testing to rule out other causes such as TTN or sepsis.

REQUEST TEST: Arterial_Blood_Gas, Pulse_Oximetry, Blood_Culture, CBC_with_Diff, CRP
REQUEST TEST: Chest_X-Ray
REQUEST IMAGES
